en:
Welcome to Pong!

Controls
- Move up: Up Arrow
- Move down: Down Arrow
- Hold Right Arrow: move forward and charge a power shot
  (release when the ball hits your paddle)
- Esc: pause

How to win
Classic: reach 30 points and beat the final boss
Hardcore: survive as long as you can to earn coins,
then open cases for paddle skins and ball trails

Good luck!
zh_CN:
欢迎来到乒乓！

操作
- 向上：↑ 方向键
- 向下：↓ 方向键
- 按住 → 方向键：向前移动并蓄力
  （球碰到球拍时松开，打出蓄力快球）
- Esc：暂停

怎样获胜
经典模式：拿到 30 分，打败最终 BOSS
硬核模式：尽量活得久，赚金币，
然后去「开箱」获得球拍皮肤和球拖尾

祝你好运！

en:
What's new — Version 2.0

- Upgraded to Godot 4
- Cases: CS2-style case opening for paddle skins and ball trails
- Backpack: see and equip everything you own
- Power-ups: long paddle, multiball, slow opponent
- Charged power shot (hold Right Arrow)
- Boss skills: decoy balls and darkness
- Moving bricks and portals as you level up
- Smarter AI that predicts the ball; the winner of each point serves
- Full Chinese / English support (toggle on the main menu)
zh_CN:
更新内容 —— 2.0 版

- 升级到 Godot 4
- 开箱：CS2 风格开箱，获得球拍皮肤和球拖尾
- 背包：查看并装备你拥有的所有物品
- 道具：长球拍、多球、对手减速
- 蓄力快球（按住 → 方向键）
- BOSS 技能：假球和黑暗
- 升级后出现移动砖块和传送门
- 更聪明的 AI（会预判球路）；每一分由得分方发球
- 完整中英文支持（主菜单可切换）
